```{r}
choose(200, 40)*((1/6)^40 )*((5/6)^160)
```

```{r}
# X is the number of heads in 4 coin flips

dbinom(0, 4, 1/2)

dbinom(0:4, 4, 1/2)
```

```{r}
# probability of getting atmost 2 heads

pbinom(2, 4, 1/2)
pbinom(2.5, 4, 1/2)
sum(dbinom(0:2, 4, 1/2))
```

```{r}
1 - pbinom(2, 4, 1/2) # prob of getting more than 2 heads
pbinom(2, 4, 1/2, lower.tail = F)


1 - pbinom(1,4,1/2) # prob of getting atleast 2 heads
pbinom(1,4,1/2, lower.tail = F)

```

```{r}
qbinom(0.5, 4, 1/2)
qbinom(0.6, 4, 1/2)
```

```{r}
qbinom(1-0.6, 4, 1/2)
qbinom(0.6, 4, 1/2, lower.tail = F)
```

```{r}
# randomly repeat the 4 coin flips, 100 times

rbinom(100, 4, 1/2)

```
```{r}
gbinom(4, 1/2)
gbinom(4, 0.2)
